call_points.text: Management targets stable, consistent margin improvement rather than a specific number.
Growth came from pricing and yield actions, including exiting loss-making lanes and customers, not volume.
Fuel surcharge rose after local diesel prices increased in mid-May and Brent rose from March, offsetting fuel cost.
Two major hubs were added in the North and a couple of medium hubs in the East; South hub expansion is a few quarters away.
Management declined to give vertical-wise numbers or a volume growth forecast for FY27.
E-commerce on ground continues to be the primary growth driver for the company.
General Price Increase (GPI) implemented from January 1 provided a positive impact to mitigate year-on-year inflation.
Aircraft maintenance and engine servicing capex is recurring at ₹100 Cr to ₹150 Cr annually.

operating_notes.text: Ground express and e-commerce continue to serve as the key volume growth drivers.
Tonnage was 364,430 tons and shipments 96.15 million in Q1FY27, with e-commerce at 50-plus million shipments.
Freighter pallet utilisation was 85-90% and belly cargo 30-40% of overall load in a typical month.
BFSI documents and cards are 10-15% of total revenue, with documents and small parcels together at 25-30%.
Launched International Parcel Connect for B2C cross-border parcel shipping starting with the United States.

timeline.summary: Blue Dart Express Limited’s Board of Directors, led by **Mr. Rajesh Kumar Jain (Chairman & Managing Director)**, recommended a final dividend of ₹25 per equity share for FY2025-26 on May 9, 2026.
Blue Dart Express Limited’s **Tushar Jayant Gunderia (Head, Legal & Compliance)** hosted an earnings call on May 13, 2026, with analysts/institutional investors via M/s. Motilal Oswal.
Blue Dart Express released its investor presentation for May 2026 detailing FY26 financial performance and operational highlights.
Blue Dart Express reported FY26 revenue of ₹6,141 Cr and hosted its earnings call on May 13, 2026.
On 5 August 2026 Blue Dart's Q1FY27 call reported revenue of ₹1,658 Cr and PAT of ₹87 Cr, with growth led by pricing and yield actions rather than volume.
Blue Dart launched International Parcel Connect, a B2C cross-border parcel shipping service starting with the US.
On October 27, 2026, Blue Dart Express issued a postal ballot notice seeking shareholder approval for the appointment of R.S. Subramanian as Managing Director effective November 30, 2026.
